{"settings":"{
  // API SPEC profile
  "window.title": "${activeRepositoryName} - ${profileName} profile",
  "workbench.iconTheme": "vs-nomo-dark",
  "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
    // Background colors
    "titleBar.activeBackground": "#6a8a5d",
    "titleBar.inactiveBackground": "#6a8a5d",
    "activityBar.background": "#6a8a5d",
    "statusBar.background": "#6a8a5d",
    // Borders
    "titleBar.border": "#6a8a5d",
    "statusBar.border": "#6a8a5d",
    // Foreground colors
    "statusBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.activeForeground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff"
  },
  "openapi.defaultPreviewRenderer": "redoc",
  "files.autoSave": "afterDelay",
  "typelens.exclude": [
    "*.http"
  ],
  "typelens.skiplanguages": [
    "csharp",
    "jsonc",
    "http"
  ],
  "javascript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "playwright.reuseBrowser": false,
  "playwright.showTrace": false,
  "typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "editor.formatOnPaste": true,
  "files.autoSaveDelay": 10000,
  "workbench.activityBar.location": "top",
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows": "PowerShell",
  "window.customTitleBarVisibility": "windowed",
  "workbench.statusBar.visible": false,
  "window.menuBarVisibility": "compact",
  "workbench.layoutControl.enabled": false,
  "window.newWindowProfile": "Backend",
  "workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMinWidth": 100,
  "workbench.colorTheme": "Monokai Dimmed",
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "workbench.sideBar.location": "right",
  "editor.minimap.size": "fit",
  "cSpell.userWords": [
    "Correlation",
    "Date",
    "decommissioned",
    "Electricity",
    "Frame",
    "Fuse",
    "geographical",
    "Latitude",
    "Longitude",
    "loss",
    "navigation",
    "production",
    "purpose",
    "ratio",
    "Remark",
    "responses",
    "string",
    "successfully",
    "tariff",
    "true",
    "wyświetlić"
  ],
  "cSpell.language": "pl",
  "cSpell.enabledNotifications": {
    "Average Word Length too Long": false
  },
  "yaml.validate": false,
  "[yaml]": {
    "editor.formatOnPaste": false,
    "editor.formatOnSave": false
  },
  "workbench.editor.showTabs": "none",
  "github.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.enabled": true
}"}
